aarti.tek: Victory to you, Ambā Gaurī; Mother, victory to you, Śyāmā Gaurī. Hari, Brahmā and Śiva meditate on you night and day.
aarti.pad1: Vermilion shines in the parting of your hair, and on your brow is a mark of musk. Your two eyes look bright, and your moon-like face is lovely. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Your body is like gold, and a red robe looks splendid on you. A garland of red flowers adorns your neck. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Your mount, the lion, looks splendid; you bear a sword and a skull-bowl. Gods, men and sages serve you, and you take away their sorrows. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Earrings shine in your ears, and a pearl at the tip of your nose. Your radiance shines like that of millions of moons and suns. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: You tore apart Śumbha and Niśumbha; you are the slayer of Mahiṣāsura, and of Dhūmravilocana too; your eyes are night and day flushed with fervour. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: You destroyed Caṇḍa and Muṇḍa and did away with Śoṇitabīja (Raktabīja); you slew both Madhu and Kaiṭabha and made the gods free from fear. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: You are Brahmāṇī and Rudrāṇī; you are Queen Kamalā. The Āgamas and the Vedas tell your praise; you are Śiva's chief queen. ॥7॥
aarti.pad8: The sixty-four yoginīs sing, and Bhairava dances. Cymbals and the mṛdaṅga play, and the ḍamaru sounds as well. ॥8॥
aarti.pad9: You alone are the mother of the world; you alone are its sustainer. You take away the sorrow of your devotees and bestow happiness and wealth. ॥9॥
aarti.pad10: Your four arms are most splendid, and you show the gesture of granting boons. The men and women who serve you gain the fruit their hearts desire. ॥10॥
aarti.pad11: A golden platter shines, with a wick of agarwood and camphor. In Śrīmālaketu shines the light of millions of gems. ॥11॥
aarti.pad12: Whoever sings the āratī of Ambā, says Śivānanda Svāmī, gains happiness and wealth. ॥12॥
